questions.questionText:
The coefficient of static friction,  m s , between block
A of mass 2 kg and the table as shown in the figure
is 0.2. What would be the maximum mass value of
block B so that the two blocks do not move ? The
string and the pulley are assumed to be smooth
and massless. ($g = 10$ m/s^2 )

A block of mass 0.1 kg. is pressed against a wall with a horizontal force of  5N as shown in the figure. If the coefficient of friction between the wall and the block
is 0.5 then the frictional force acting on the block
will be ($g = 9.8$ m/s^2 ) :-

Adjoining figure shows two blocks A and B pushed
against the wall with a force F. The wall is smooth
but the surfaces in contact of A and B are rough.
Which of the following is true for the system of blocks
to be at rest against the wall ?
questions.optionsJson: [{"key":"A","text":"F should be be more than the weight of A and B"},{"key":"B","text":"F should be equal to the weight of A and B"},{"key":"C","text":"F should be less than the weight of A and B"},{"key":"D","text":"system cannot be in equilibrium"}]

questions.questionText:

2 kg 5 kg

depend on
